decision: Documented upstream provenance supports the fixed official personal-media installation route. This is not an assertion of blanket third-party relicensing or authorization to mirror/repackage the game's resources.

licence.name: MIT
licence.scope: Upstream grant for its software and associated documentation, limited to rights it can grant. Third-party game graphics, dialogue, credits and notices are not declared to have been independently relicensed.

groups.origin: Project development-history gallery, March–September 2020. INTRO and sampled slides identify REDRIVER2 progress; screenshots include original-game graphics.
groups.licence_scope: Upstream project documentation; no independent relicensing claim over third-party graphics visible in screenshots.

groups.origin: Game/source strings externalized to locale files, with maintained translations. The German addition expressly credits @Jordem.
groups.licence_scope: Attributed project contributions with source-game strings; not described as entirely original dialogue or independently relicensed commercial text.

groups.origin: Replacement chase recordings maintained by upstream. The Mission 10 update expressly records a new chase recording; official Driver2CutsceneTool assembles REDRIVER2 replay inputs.
groups.licence_scope: Identified project recordings/fixes. Do not substitute original-disc replays or silently omit the replacements.

groups.origin: SBN text/timing metadata added by SoapyMan for the official subtitle implementation/exporter. 7384 bytes total; 24 nonempty files and two empty files. The 56-byte record format accounts for 130 subtitle entries; inspected samples contain timed game dialogue, not audio.
groups.licence_scope: Project formatting/timing contributions reproduce game dialogue. The exporter needs WAV cue/LIST annotations; ordinary PCM conversion alone does not reconstruct these exact subtitles.

groups.origin: Original-game credits/notices adapted for the port, with a project-specific final line discussed publicly by a collaborator and subsequently edited.
groups.licence_scope: Preserve original Infogrames/Reflections and music attribution notices. This text file does not contain the credited music recordings.

payload_policy.download: Only the fixed unmodified official release, directly from upstream; no GetAll mirror or repackaged game assets.
payload_policy.media: The user's separately selected and cryptographically verified pair of supported original discs.
payload_policy.preserve: All 93 baseline files, including all 76 extras, remain unchanged through publication. Preserve original notices. Generated AVI/WAV are added locally. Subsequent ordinary config.ini preference edits are allowed; the other 92 baseline files and both added notices remain pinned at launch.
payload_policy.companion_scope: Added only to the completed payload, outside the 93-file baseline. Recorded in the final manifest and verified at launch.
payload_policy.disc_path: The pinned PC CLI accepts an arbitrary absolute -cdimage path; use selected disc 1. Its DiscSwapped implementation returns CDTYPE_CORRECTDISC, while converted FMV/XA from both discs are local. No imposed original image filename or runtime disc-2 swap is required.

evidence_limits.synthetic_conversion: Existing authored 96-frame STR fixture validates the pinned converter and merge path only; it is not an original disc, completed game installation or boot test.

issue234.interpretation: An unanswered provenance question is not proof of impossibility or illegality.

runtime.scope: Private temporary JDK prepared after both original discs are verified; no system installation or global JAVA_HOME changes.
runtime.implementation: Shared MkddAltJdk21 / ExtractConsolePackage cache verification; unchanged runtime archive.
